title: Show one PCB layer in single-layer mode
summary: Switches the PCB editor into single-layer mode through IPCB_SystemOptions.SingleLayerMode and makes a chosen layer current with CurrentLayerV7, reading both back; shows that the PCB:SetupPreferences process call has no effect.
phrasings: turn on single layer mode from code
change a PCB editor preference programmatically

commands.name: HighlightLayer
commands.description: Turn on single-layer mode and make a layer current
commands.params: Layer=<TV6_Layer name or board layer name> (default Top Layer)|Via=Property|Process (default Property)|Off=true (optional)
